Andhra Pradesh CM meets young girl aspiring to be IAS officer

Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu met a young girl named Aarana, who aspires to become an IAS officer. A video of their interaction, where Aarana reportedly left a meeting to meet the Chief Minister, was shared by Naidu. The Chief Minister expressed his admiration for her ambition and wished her well.
